name: Token sale

subjectOf.text: Because almost all other blockchains distribute perfectly fungible currency tokens through initial sales or mining, there is a clear, computable answer to how much it would cost to corrupt or destroy a chain running a proof of stake protocol on cryptocurrency stakes.
subjectOf.abstract: Either way, these tokens are almost always perfectly fungible currencies, so there is a clear answer to how much it would cost to corrupt or destroy blockchain running a PoS protocol based on cryptocurrency stakes.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Secure Proof of Stake Protocol (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125827
scope_conditions: PoS chains whose stakes are perfectly fungible currency tokens

subjectOf.text: The DAO raised more than 150 million dollars from approximately 10,000 investors through a crowdfunding campaign in May 2016, with DAO Tokens designed to be fully transferable and tradable on peer-to-peer exchanges like shares in a listed corporation.
subjectOf.abstract: The DAO raised more than $150 million from approximately 10,000 "investors." Like shares in a traditional listed corporation, DAO Tokens were designed to be fully transferable and tradable on "peer-to-peer" exchanges.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Why 'Blockchain' Will Disrupt Corporate Organizations (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3227933

subjectOf.text: A DAO token sale can be drained at the moment of closing: in the Anubis DAO sale 13597 ETH was removed from the token sale pool and sent to another address as the sale was about to close, and because the launch platform had not been compromised the loss was attributed to an inside rug pull.
subjectOf.abstract: As the sale was about to close, 13597 ETH was removed from the token sale pool and sent to another address. Allegations of a rug pull ensued because the launch platform Copper had not been compromised.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783
scope_conditions: Anubis DAO token sale on the Copper platform, October 2021
